themes.description: 3 champion buffs, 4 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: All your sci-fi skins are belong to us. Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.

champions.name: Dr. Mundo
champions.tldr: Monster damage cap reduced to 250–550 from 300–600.; Monster damage reduced to 140% from 200%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Dr. Mundo loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Monster damage cap
lines.note: Monster damage cap reduced to 250–550 from 300–600.

champions.name: Elise
champions.gameplayImpact: Elise was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

champions.name: Hwei
champions.tldr: Base damage increased to 40–285 from 35–230.; New Effect: Slows now stack with and slows at diminishing value.
champions.gameplayImpact: Hwei was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Slows now stack with and slows at diminishing value.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Slows no longer ignore slow resist.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Slows no longer stack with other slows sourced from allies, items, etc.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Previously, and slows would stack with each other aswell as with every other slow in the game, this change causes all slows sourced from Hwei's abilities stack with each other but prevents them from stacking with slows from any other source. This should have minor buff for EQ + R/QE slow, but a minor nerf to how hwei interacts with ally's slows[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1s948mv/comment/odnp5nw Reddit: Riot Beluga on Hwei changes]
